description: This file defines the PluginRegistry class for managing plugin components, actions, hooks, and integrations within the Mattermost web application. It includes methods for registering UI components, event handlers, WebSocket events, Redux reducers, and plugin-specific configurations.

classes.name: PluginRegistry
classes.description: A class providing methods to register, unregister, and manage various plugin components, actions, hooks, and configurations within the Mattermost application.

methods.name: dispatchPluginComponentAction
methods.description: Dispatches an action to register a plugin component with a specific name and plugin ID.

methods.name: dispatchPluginComponentWithData
methods.description: Dispatches an action to register a plugin component with provided data.

methods.name: resolveReactElement
methods.description: Resolves a React component or element, creating a React element if a component type is provided.

methods.name: standardizeRoute
methods.description: Removes leading slashes and trims whitespace from route strings.
